verdict.rationale: Ardent ships its own ardent-cli skill: with it installed in a coding agent, "a short ask is enough" and the skill fetches the docs and works through setup. The docs also say agents can run the Ardent CLI themselves to create, use and delete branches. Natural-language operation therefore works only through an external agent, and only setup is explicitly described as driven by a plain-language ask. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface, documented natural-language operation beyond setup (branching, deletion, connector management), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With the ardent-cli skill installed, a short ask is enough — the skill fetches the current docs and works through setup
The agent runs the Ardent CLI itself — creating, using, and deleting its own branches
